mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workitem_duplicate_check (tenant_id, operator_id, workitem_id, form_request_id, title, title_fingerprint, exclude_workitem_id, candidate_since, candidate_total, candidate_snapshot_json, next_batch_index, request_id, status, cancel_pending, error, deadline_at, attempt, gmt_create) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{operatorId}, #{workitemId}, #{formRequestId}, #{title}, #{titleFingerprint}, #{excludeWorkitemId}, #{candidateSince}, COALESCE(#{candidateTotal}, 0), #{candidateSnapshotJson}, COALESCE(#{nextBatchIndex}, 0), #{requestId}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{cancelPending}, 0), #{error}, #{deadlineAt}, 0, #{gmtCreate})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM workitem_duplicate_check WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workitem_duplicate_check WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workitem_duplicate_check WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')

SELECT id FROM workitem_duplicate_check WHERE id > #{afterId} AND (status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now}))) AND (deadline_at IS NULL OR deadline_at > #{now}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE workitem_duplicate_check SET candidate_snapshot_json = #{candidateSnapshotJson}, candidate_total = #{candidateTotal}, lease_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND attempt = #{expectedAttempt} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND candidate_snapshot_json IS NULL
UPDATE workitem_duplicate_check SET lease_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND attempt = #{expectedAttempt} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE workitem_duplicate_check SET status = #{status}, match_json = #{matchJson}, error = #{error}, lease_until = NULL, cancel_pending = 0 WHERE id = #{id} AND attempt = #{expectedAttempt} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND (#{status} <> 'SUCCEEDED' OR deadline_at IS NULL OR deadline_at > #{now})

UPDATE workitem_duplicate_check SET status = 'FAILED', error = #{error}, lease_until = NULL, cancel_pending = CASE WHEN request_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND deadline_at IS NOT NULL AND deadline_at <= #{now}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM workitem_duplicate_check WHERE cancel_pending = 1 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE workitem_duplicate_check SET cancel_pending = 0 WHERE id = #{id} AND cancel_pending = 1

UPDATE workitem_duplicate_check SET status = 'CANCELED', lease_until = NULL, cancel_pending = 0 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND workitem_id = #{workitemId} AND operator_id = #{operatorId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM workitem_duplicate_check WHERE id IN #{id}
